params.amountUqor: amount in uqor (1 QOR = 1e6); must equal msg.value/1e12
params.invoiceKey: keccak256 of the invoice identifier the payment        settles (`qg-inv:v1:<vendorId>:<invoiceId>`). The same key is        what `payWithApproval` checks, so the invoice is paid once no        matter which lane is used, or how many times either is tried.
params.vendorId: id assigned by the owner in a PQ-signed `addVendor`

adminMessage(bytes32,bytes32,uint256).notice: The exact message an owner signs for an administrative action.         Everything binds the chain, this contract and the nonce, so a         signature cannot be replayed here or on another deployment.

approvalNonce().notice: Monotonic counter bound into every owner signature (replay guard).

exceptionMessage(uint256,uint256,bytes32.notice: The exact message an owner signs to approve one over-cap payment.

ownerAccount().notice: The 0x address of the treasury owner (the PQC-required account).

paidInvoices(bytes32).notice: Invoice settlement record shared by both payment lanes: the         invoice identifier (a bytes32 that commits to the vendor and the         invoice id) maps to "already paid". Written only together with a         successful transfer, read before every payment.

pay(uint256,uint256,bytes32).notice: Pay a registered vendor inside every cap, once per invoice.

payWithApproval(uint256,uint256,bytes32,.notice: Exception path: a payment above a vendor cap that the owner         approved with a fresh ML-DSA-87 signature over exactly these         arguments. The agent can submit it, but can never create it.         The invoice guard is the same one `pay` uses, and it is checked         before the signature: an invoice that is already settled stays         settled even under a fresh owner approval.

settledInvoiceCount().notice: How many distinct invoices this treasury has settled.

treasuryDailyCapUqor().notice: Treasury-wide cap on everything the agent may pay in one UTC day.
